mapper.select: select u.U_Name as qegdUname, c.C_Name as qegdCompanyName, c.C_Abbreviation as qegdCompAbbName, c1.C_Name as qegdCname, sqgd.* from Sec_QE_Group_Dtl sqgd left join Sys_User u on sqgd.Qegd_Uid = u.U_ID left join SYS_Company c on c.C_ID = u.C_ID left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID = sqgd.Qegd_Cid where sqgd.Qeg_Id = #{qegId}

select u.U_Name as qegdUname, c.C_Name as qegdCompanyName, c.C_Abbreviation as qegdCompAbbName, c1.C_Name as qegdCname, sqgd.* from Sec_QE_Group_Dtl sqgd left join Sys_User u on sqgd.Qegd_Uid = u.U_ID left join SYS_Company c on c.C_ID = u.C_ID left join Sec_QE_Group sqg on sqg.Qeg_Id = sqgd.Qeg_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = sqg.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID = sqgd.Qegd_Cid where sec.Sec_Id = #{secId}
